rule: A puzzle area is a recognizable place. Neither an engine ID nor a disconnected chunk component automatically creates one. Masks below are unions of source cells for review, not final valid-start masks.

excludedSources.main/lake/1133f1/4-0: Blank sky above the Cloudscape near the Gourd room; not a separate Lake or puzzle area.
excludedSources.main/winter/d6d8e3/11-0: Blank elevated strip, not a separate Snowy Wasteland or puzzle area.

groups.reason: One EDR recognition area across all source fragments, including the small patch above the Ancient Laboratory. Keep biome and room holes. Normal scoring: 1000 area + 4000 proximity. The material is easy to recognize; Tower context may help pinpoint the position without creating another EDR area.
One Pyramid, including all entrance, hallway, top and side construction pieces.

One surface Snowy Wasteland. The original starting view determines the tier: any snow pixels means Normal (1000/4000); no snow pixels means Hard (3000/2000). Zooming or moving later does not reclassify the round. Source biome labels or general color variation cannot substitute for checking snow in that view. Unclassified starts require review.
One Snowy Chasm. The six embedded winter-texture patches belong to this place; they are not six extra Snowy Wasteland puzzles.
Frozen Vault includes the bridge and the populated cavern entrance directly below it. Neither the bridge nor the empty-labelled entrance is a separate puzzle area.
Procedural laboratory rooms, separate from the Alchemist boss room.
Separate ornate Alchemist boss room. The Ylialkemisti marker at (-4840,851) lies here, outside the procedural laboratory mask.
The two terrain variants form one Underground Jungle. Separate Fungal Caverns enclaves and named room masks remain holes.
One Lukki Lair; its small adjacent source fragment is part of the same geographic complex.
Main Fungal Caverns beside Coal Pits; distinct from the two distant jungle enclaves.
Separate Fungal Caverns enclave inside the jungle, not part of the main caverns.
A second separate Fungal Caverns enclave at the jungle/Vault edge.

The main Meat Realm includes its differently labelled meat room. This is the user's boss-room reference. Named room puzzles can later declare a more specific footprint; do not merge the distant secondary realm.
The distant secondary Meat Realm is a separate physical place.
The main Power Plant complex. Its own room is included in the parent mask; the remote elevator sharing robobase is a different area.

groups.label: Infinite Hiidet elevator
groups.reason: One continuous 512-pixel-wide elevator strip, including the Hell continuation; separate from Power Plant.

groups.label: The Tower
groups.labelOverrideReason: User-requested English display name; common.csv supplies Tower.
groups.reason: One Tower structure across its floor variants, reward pieces and enclosure. No automatic hard recognition rating. Generic EDR remains in the EDR recognition area.
The actual Lake and its deep continuation form one place. Elevated blank sky carrying the lake ID is excluded.
Lava and its construction variants form one Volcanic Lake area. Vertical projections still need capture validation, not independent questions.
One captured Heaven region across the main/vertical allocation boundary. Named landmarks still need their explicit footprints.
One captured Hell region across the main/vertical allocation boundary. Named landmarks still need their explicit footprints.
One Hiisi Base, including its side cavern allocations; a named shop or scene may later have its own footprint.
The Laboratory and its top construction segment form one area.

singleAreas.coalmine: Mines, with separately defined Collapsed Mines and room allocations kept distinct.
singleAreas.coalmine_alt: Collapsed Mines is a distinct area beside the Mines.
singleAreas.excavationsite: Coal Pits; the main Fungal Caverns remain a separate area.
singleAreas.snowcave: Snowy Depths, separate from the western Snowy Chasm.
singleAreas.vault: The main Vault; the Frozen Vault is a different physical place.
singleAreas.crypt: Temple of the Art; nearby Magical Temple instances remain separate.
singleAreas.mountain_tree: The tree is one area. A future puzzle samples a valid position within it, not the old fixed test coordinate.
singleAreas.gourd_room: The Gourd room is a real landmark; the blank sky near it is not another area.
singleAreas.biome_barren: One Barren Temple instance; helper lighting strips do not create more questions.
singleAreas.biome_potion_mimics: One Henkevä Temple instance; its final occupied footprint needs capture review.
singleAreas.biome_darkness: One Ominous Temple instance; its final occupied footprint needs capture review.
singleAreas.biome_boss_sky: One Kivi Temple instance; its final occupied footprint needs capture review.
singleAreas.biome_watchtower: One Watchtower instance; do not promote each construction cell separately.
singleAreas.watercave: One Dark Cave location; source-art variants do not create extra places.

pendingLandmarks.reason: The seventh and lowest Holy Mountain, immediately beside Kolmi, uses Easy scoring (500 area + 4500 proximity). Its room lies within the larger Laboratory source scene. Trace this room separately before sampling; do not mislabel the sixth ordinary Holy Mountain or the entire boss arena as this exception.
